biotools.summary: RepEnTools is a software package for genome-wide repeat element enrichment analysis of ChIP-seq and similar chromatin pulldown experiments, bundling various software with carefully chosen and validated settings to provide a complete solution from raw input files to tabular and graphical outputs.
